next.reason: 1985 GR3: WRITE ... FROM is equivalent to 'MOVE identifier-1 TO record-name-1' per the MOVE rules, then the same WRITE without FROM. §2023:14.9.51.4 GR5 keeps the identical equivalence for identifier-1. Its additions do not touch a conforming 1985 program: 'MOVE literal-1 TO record-name-1' serves FROM literal-1, syntax 1985's format refuses, and NOTE 1's overlap case needs identifier-1 and record-name-1 to share storage, which 1985 SR1 forbids. Same (as 1985-GR-IX.4.9.4-3).
